prompt: Buatkan spesifikasi teknis untuk modul manajemen armada. Arsitektur, schema, API-nya sekalian.
anti_pattern: Producing a blueprint with no agreed requirement set to trace to — inventing the requirements implicitly inside the design instead of stopping and routing to /discovering-requirements, which leaves every decision uncheckable because nothing says what it was supposed to serve.

prompt: Ini requirement-nya sudah fix di docs/discovery. Langsung susun cetak biru arsitekturnya ya.
anti_pattern: Designing components and boundaries without first reading the existing code — no path:line citations, no statement of what was searched for and not found, so the design ignores the seam that already exists and gets rewritten at the first merge.

prompt: Tulis spec-nya, sekalian masukkan potongan kode dan path file-nya biar developer tinggal ikut.
anti_pattern: Embedding file paths and code snippets in the spec body. Those go stale within a month and the spec stops being trusted. Citations belong in the evidence log; the only snippet allowed in the body is one that encodes a decision more precisely than prose — a schema, a state machine, a type shape.

prompt: Spec-nya sudah ada diagram arsitektur, ERD, dan sequence. Cukup kan?
anti_pattern: Treating diagrams as the specification. Every section must open with plain language before anything technical — the reader most likely to catch a wrong process is the one least able to read the notation, and a diagram-only spec excludes exactly them.

prompt: Untuk kontrak API-nya cukup tulis endpoint, request, dan response-nya saja.
anti_pattern: Documenting only the happy path. Each operation must also name its error cases, whether it is safe to retry, and who is authorised — the columns that get skipped are the ones that cause incidents.

prompt: Acceptance criteria-nya: AC-1 — sistem menyimpan data dengan benar ke database.
anti_pattern: Writing an acceptance criterion that can only be checked by reading the code or inspecting the database directly. An AC must name an observable consequence in Given/When/Then and cite exactly one requirement ID, or it is worthless both as a test case and as the oracle for UAT.

prompt: Semua requirement sudah tercakup kok, arsitekturnya sudah lengkap. Lanjut ke plan.
anti_pattern: Asserting coverage without the coverage table — every requirement ID must appear in exactly one row, either claimed by a component or carried by an explicit out-of-scope row. Silent scope loss is invisible until acceptance.

prompt: Setiap keputusan desain di spec ini kita jadikan ADR ya biar terdokumentasi rapi.
anti_pattern: ADR inflation. A decision earns an ADR only when all three hold — hard to reverse, surprising without context, and a genuine trade-off. Otherwise the decision row in the spec is the record; an ADR for everything is an ADR for nothing.

prompt: Implementasinya ternyata beda dari spec yang sudah AGREED, tapi jalan kok. Biarkan saja.
anti_pattern: Accepting silent divergence. Exactly one of two things is true — the code is wrong, or the spec is out of date and gets amended through its change log. Leaving both is how a spec becomes fiction that the next reader still trusts.

prompt: Tolong tambah kolom catatan di form pengajuan. Bikin spec-nya dulu dong.
anti_pattern: Running the full seven-stage blueprint on a small change with an obvious, reversible design — instead of saying so in one line and doing the work. The skill's cost must stay proportional to the design risk it removes.

prompt: Biar rapi, kita pecah jadi service terpisah untuk notifikasi, audit, dan reporting.
anti_pattern: Adding seams without pricing them. Every boundary is a contract to maintain, a place data can diverge, and a thing to test — an existing seam is preferred, the fewest that work is the target, and the rejected alternative plus its cost must be written down in the decision row.

prompt: Semua stage sudah saya jalankan kok. Ini spec-nya, langsung review saja.
anti_pattern: A spec with no gate table, or a gate table whose PASS rows have empty evidence cells — which is byte-identical to what an agent that ran nothing produces. A PASS without evidence is not a PASS, and a gate whose subject does not exist reads n/a, never PASS.

prompt: Desainnya sudah final dan saya setuju. Tandai AGREED ya.
anti_pattern: The agent setting status to AGREED itself. That transition needs named humans with roles and a date — business owner and technical owner — and the agent never grants it, however clearly the user approves in chat.

prompt: Ringkasan bisnisnya: layanan ini mempublikasikan event idempoten dengan eventual consistency ke consumer hilir.
anti_pattern: Accepting that as the plain-language layer. It contains no project-specific nouns, so it survives the first test — and it is not plain language. Industry vocabulary is jargon too; the sentence must use only terms a person doing the work would use in a meeting.

prompt: Entity-nya: Inspeksi, key-nya id, punya status dan tanggal. Lanjut ke kontrak.
anti_pattern: Passing Stage 3 without a grain statement, a key stability statement, or a temporality. One row of Inspeksi could mean one inspection event or one vessel-per-cycle, the surrogate may or may not survive a reload, and current-state-only silently forecloses any as-of question later.

prompt: Schema-nya sudah ada dan tabelnya sudah berisi data produksi. Ini bentuk barunya.
anti_pattern: Specifying the end state only — no transition section saying how existing rows reach the new shape, what happens to rows that do not fit, whether both shapes must be readable during rollout, what happens to work in flight, or where the point of no return is.

prompt: Komponennya sudah lengkap dengan dependensinya. Developer tinggal ambil mana saja.
anti_pattern: Presenting the dependency graph as if it were a build order. A runtime dependency is not a sequencing edge — the caller is usually buildable first against a double. Without a Blocked by column and a named first buildable slice, the implementer guesses and frequently starts with the one thing that cannot be built yet.

prompt: Proses bisnisnya sudah saya gambar: submit, verifikasi, approve, selesai. Ada juga cabang timeout-nya.
anti_pattern: Treating one unhappy branch as sufficient. Every terminal outcome that is not success needs a path with a named handler — rejected, expired, abandoned, failed — and every returnable route must say how the person gets back in. The rejection routes are usually most of the real volume.

prompt: Constraint C-2 soal retensi sudah tercatat di discovery, jadi tidak perlu diulang di spec.
anti_pattern: Leaving a constraint undischarged. Every C-n must be claimed by a component or carried by an explicit out-of-scope row citing its ID — otherwise a constraint that survived discovery's blocking gate vanishes at the spec boundary with every gate still reading PASS.
